subject: Cochlear implant pipeline kickoff — from hackathon code to accessibility demo
body:
Hi Bruno,

Kicking off the cochlear implant effort. Our open-source hackathon submission takes input audio — music, speech in noise — applies speech enhancement primarily when music is NOT detected, and generates electrodograms for cochlear implants. The clever bit is the mixing strategy: because enhancement tends to strip music as if it were noise, the pipeline uses YAMNet to estimate music content and causally mix original and enhanced audio.

Why now: the accessibility roadmap has a hearing-assistance line item for H2, and this is our strongest asset. Goal (Feb 16 – Jul 6): productize the notebooks into a pipeline, establish evaluation with vocoder simulation for listening checks, retrain the enhancement model on our current speech corpora, and land a Launch Review-approved internal demo.

Bruno — staffing + compute please. The retraining is the only heavy item.

Goran
